_readme: Hexa's own curated style presets. Each maps to a mode/product, prefills selections, and carries an art-direction seed that the brain merges with the recipe (and the backend --enhance-only prompt). These are Hexa IP, not Higgsfield preset IDs.

presets.name: Golden Hour UGC
presets.seed: Late-afternoon golden hour, warm rim light, soft lens flare, relaxed handheld energy, creator smiling into the sun.

presets.name: Gym Rat
presets.seed: Gym floor, chalk and sweat, hard directional light, post-set adrenaline, product gripped mid-rep.

presets.name: Street Style
presets.seed: City sidewalk, overcast diffused light, candid walk-and-talk, ambient street sound, effortless cool.

presets.name: Unbox ASMR
presets.seed: Soft desk lamp, tight macro on hands, deliberate slow reveal, crisp tactile ASMR sound design, tissue and wrap.

presets.name: Kitchen Counter Demo
presets.seed: Bright kitchen counter, clean daylight from a window, three tidy steps, hands-focused inserts, satisfying result.

presets.name: Editorial Try-On
presets.seed: Studio seamless backdrop, controlled soft key with clean shadow, deliberate slow movement, catalog-grade fabric fidelity.

presets.name: Bullet Time Hero
presets.seed: Single continuous impossible camera move, slow 360 orbit into a dive, product tack-sharp while the world speed-blurs.

presets.name: Midnight Product Drop
presets.seed: Dark premium set, cold steel palette, backlit contre-jour rim, confident slow push-in, macro over material and label.

presets.name: Neon Nights
presets.seed: Neon-drenched night city, practical light sources, reflective wet surfaces, kinetic impossible camera, product as the glowing hero.

presets.name: Sun-Bleached Beauty
presets.seed: Soft bleached-warm grade, window light, intimate observational framing, dewy skin and gentle highlights, beauty-editorial calm.

presets.name: Studio White
presets.seed: Seamless white sweep, even softbox light, crisp contact shadow, true-to-reference color, ten clean catalog compositions.

presets.name: Lifestyle Flatlay
presets.seed: Styled lifestyle surface with tasteful props, warm natural light, believable scale and shadow, ten distinct in-context frames.
